name: idea-research
description: Finds the right thing to build in a founder's direction. Research agents dig, two agents argue the case for and against from the same research, a reconciler names the sharpest play and its runners-up (a white space, or a copy of a proven player) and tests whether a stated constraint should be relaxed, scripts gate the run, and the answer defines its own terms. India-first, plain English, state on disk.
